cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the back, hips, knees, ankles, and wall visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the upper body upright and supported by the wall.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed upright against the wall.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned away from the wall. Press the back gently into the wall.

metrics.targetText: Place the feet so the shins stay close to vertical.
metrics.hint_good: Your foot position kept the knees balanced.
metrics.hint_low: The knees stayed too far behind the ankles. Adjust the feet slightly if comfortable.
metrics.hint_high: The knees moved too far forward. Move the feet a little farther from the wall.

metrics.targetText: Use a shallow wall sit near a 135-degree knee angle.
metrics.hint_good: You reached the intended shallow wall sit depth.
metrics.hint_low: You lowered deeper than this exercise needs. Slide up slightly.
metrics.hint_high: The knees were almost straight. Slide down a little more.

metrics.targetText: Keep the knees at a steady angle.
metrics.hint_good: Your shallow wall sit stayed steady.
metrics.hint_high: Your body moved up and down. Keep one comfortable depth.
